message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta. Noise complaints are typically handled by the **City of Atlanta Police Department** or the **City’s Code Enforcement Division**, depending on the nature of the disturbance. ### How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta | Method | What to Do | Contact | |--------|------------|---------| | **Online** | • Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website:
• Navigate to “Services” → “Code Enforcement” → “File a Complaint.”
• Select “Noise” as the complaint type and fill out the required information. | Online portal (no phone number needed) | | **Phone** | • Call the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line: **(404) 656‑4000**.
• Tell the dispatcher you’d like to file a noise complaint. They’ll guide you through the process or forward your call to the appropriate unit. | (404) 656‑4000 | | **In‑person** | • Visit the nearest police precinct or the City Hall’s Code Enforcement office.
• Bring any evidence (e.g., photos, videos, timestamps) that supports your claim. | City Hall: 55 Marietta Street NW, Atlanta, GA 30303 | | **Mail** | • Send a written complaint to:
City of Atlanta – Code Enforcement
55 Marietta Street NW
Atlanta, GA 30303 | 55 Marietta Street NW, Atlanta, GA 30303 | ### Tips for Filing 1. **Provide Details** – Include the exact time(s), location, and description of the noise. If possible, attach audio/video recordings or photographs that demonstrate the disturbance. 2. **Keep Records** – Save copies of any emails, screenshots, or documents you submit. This will help you track the status of your complaint. 3. **Follow Up** – If you don’t receive a response within a few days, call the non‑emergency line again and reference your original submission. ### When to Call 911 If the noise is part of an ongoing crime (e.g., a burglary, assault, or other emergency situation), dial **911** immediately. For routine noise complaints that do not involve an immediate threat to safety, use the non‑emergency line or the online portal. --- **Bottom line:** Yes, you can report a noise complaint to the City of Atlanta. Use the online portal for convenience, or call the non‑emergency line at (404) 656‑4000 if you prefer speaking with someone directly.
